tools.name: vcqa_score
tools.description: Get the code health score and grade for the current project. Fast — uses cached results when available.

tools.name: vcqa_scan
tools.description: Run a full code health scan. Returns score, grade, and every check result with its issues. Use vcqa_score for a quicker summary.

tools.name: vcqa_file_health
tools.description: Get all code health issues for a specific file. Use before modifying a file to understand existing problems, or after to check for new issues.

file.description: File path relative to project root (e.g., 'src/auth.ts')

tools.name: vcqa_check
tools.description: Get detailed results for a specific check (e.g., 'complexity', 'security', 'testing'). Shows score, issues, and metadata.

tools.name: vcqa_explain
tools.description: Explain what a specific check measures, why it matters, and how to fix issues. Use to understand WHY a check is flagging something.

tools.name: vcqa_fix
tools.description: AI-powered fix for code quality issues. Scans the project, identifies fixable issues, and uses Claude to generate and apply fixes. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var.

check.description: Only fix issues from a specific check (e.g., 'security')

tools.name: vcqa_delta
tools.description: Compare current scan against previous scan. Shows what changed: score delta, fixed issues, new issues, per-check changes. Useful after making fixes to see impact.

tools.name: vcqa_read_file
tools.description: Read a source file from the project — the exact code the VibeCode monitor shows. Returns contents with line numbers so you can cite precise lines.

file.description: File path relative to project root, e.g. 'src/app.ts'

tools.name: vcqa_list_files
tools.description: List the project's files (skipping node_modules/dist/.git etc.) — the inventory behind the monitor's Files view. Optionally filter by extension or a path substring.

ext.description: Filter to an extension, e.g. 'ts' or '.tsx'

tools.name: vcqa_grep
tools.description: Search the project's source files for a regular expression. Returns matching 'file:line: text' — use to find where something is defined or used.

tools.name: vcqa_graph
tools.description: Get the project's module dependency graph — the nodes and edges the monitor's Graph view draws. Nodes are files (type module|ui) and external libs (type lib); edges are imports. Use to see who imports/depends on a file. Test/spec files are excluded by default (they live in the Tests view, not the structure) — pass include_tests to add them.

include_tests.description: Include *.test/*.spec and test-folder files as nodes (default false, matching the Graph view)

tools.name: vcqa_architecture
tools.description: Map the project's React architecture into layers (Routes/Pages, Components, Hooks, State/Context, Services/API, Lib/Utils, Data/DB) plus the call/import flow between layers — the same model the monitor's Architecture view shows. Symbols are classified by kind (component/hook/service/type…) from a real call graph built locally by graphify. Use to understand what layers exist, which hooks/services are defined, and how they call each other. Requires graphify (`uv tool install graphifyy`).

tools.name: vcqa_callflow
tools.description: Trace how function calls actually flow through the project — the monitor's Flow view. With no `root`, returns the entry points (symbols nothing calls, or components/hooks) ranked by how many symbols they reach. With a `root` (a function/component/hook name or id), returns its downstream call tree: each reached symbol with its call depth, plus the caller→callee edges. Use to answer 'what does X actually call?' and to see execution paths through the layers. Requires graphify (`uv tool install graphifyy`).

root.description: Entry symbol to trace from (function/component/hook name or id). Omit to list entry points.

max_depth.description: Max call depth to follow when tracing (default 6)

tools.name: vcqa_sequence
tools.description: Approximate a sequence diagram for a symbol: trace its calls in execution order (DFS pre-order — each call fully expanded before the next) and return a Mermaid `sequenceDiagram` plus the ordered steps. This is a STATIC approximation (no branches/loops/await), but shows the who-calls-whom order through the code. Requires a `root` symbol (function/component/hook name or id) and graphify (`uv tool install graphifyy`).

root.description: Entry symbol to sequence from (function/component/hook name or id)

tools.name: vcqa_app_state
tools.description: Read the running VibeCode Monitor's live UI state — which project folder and which page (view) the user is currently looking at, and whether the copilot panel is open. This is what's on the user's screen right now.

tools.name: vcqa_copilot_thread
tools.description: Read the in-app copilot's conversation for a page — the exact messages the user and the desktop copilot exchanged, including which tools it ran. Use to see what the copilot said/saw. Omit `page` to get every page's thread.

page.description: Page id, e.g. 'canopy' (Graph), 'schema', 'complexity'. Omit for all pages.

tools.name: vcqa_copilot_send
tools.description: Send a message to the running monitor's in-app copilot on a given page — as if the user typed it — and return the copilot's reply. The exchange also appears in the app UI. Requires the desktop monitor to be running. Write actions (issues/notes) never fire on a sent message.

text.description: The message to send to the copilot

timeout_s.description: How long to wait for the reply (default 90s)
